description: Simplified Bloom filter (fixed-size bit array, 2 hash functions)
prompt: Implement a class `BloomFilter` with `BloomFilter(size: int)`, `add(item: str) -> None`, and `might_contain(item: str) -> bool` (False means definitely not present; True means maybe present). Use two simple, deterministic hash functions (e.g. based on `hash(item)` with different seeds/salts) mapping into a bit array of length `size`.
